==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
When I look at a game or show on a screen in a lucid dream, it has a habit of taking on a life of its own. This can cause me to lose my lucidity and for the content on the screen to become my dream.
This is what happened in my first dream. I was so annoyed by this, that I chose to go back to sleep to have another dream. When I went back to sleep, I was able to quickly induce sleep paralysis.
While in this state, my imagination became significantly more immersive. I consumed stars. Every time I did, the dream felt more real and my body felt like it was being upgraded.
